an6.43:1.1: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
an6.43:1.2: atha kho bhagavā pubbanhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā patta cīvaramādāya sāvatthiyaṃ piṇḍāya pāvisi.
an6.43:1.3: sāvatthiyaṃ piṇḍāya caritvā pacchābhattaṃ piṇḍapāta paṭikkanto āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ āmantesi:
an6.43:1.5: “evaṃ bhante”ti kho āyasmā ānando bhagavato paccassosi.
an6.43:2.1: atha kho bhagavā āyasmatā ānandena saddhiṃ yena pubbārāmo migāramātupāsādo tenupasaṅkami.
an6.43:2.2: atha kho bhagavā sāyanhasamayaṃ patisallānā vuṭṭhito āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ āmantesi:
an6.43:2.4: “evaṃ bhante’ti kho āyasmā ānando bhagavato paccassosi”.
an6.43:2.5: atha kho bhagavā āyasmatā ānandena saddhiṃ yena pubbakoṭṭhako tenupasaṅkami gattāni parisiñcituṃ.
an6.43:2.6: pubbakoṭṭhake gattāni parisiñcitvā paccuttaritvā ekacīvaro aṭṭhāsi gattatāni pubbāpayamāno.
an6.43:3.1: tena kho pana samayena rañño pasenadissa kosalassa ‘seto’ nāma nāgo mahāturiyatālitavāditena pubbakoṭṭhakā paccuttarati.
an6.43:3.3: “abhirūpo vata bho rañño nāgo, dassanīyo vata bho rañño nāgo, pāsādiko vata bho rañño nāgo, kāyūpapanno vata bho rañño nāgo”ti.
an6.43:3.4: evaṃ vutte āyasmā udāyi bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
an6.43:3.5: “hatthimeva nu kho bhante mahantaṃ brūhantaṃ kāyūpapannaṃ jano disvā evamāha:
an6.43:3.6: nāgo vata bho nāgoti: udāhu aññampi kañci mahantaṃ brūhantaṃ kāyūpapannaṃ jano disvā evamāha: nāgo vata bho nāgoti?”
an6.43:3.7: hatthimpi kho udāyi, mahantaṃ brūhantaṃ kāyūpapannaṃ jano disvā evamāha:”
an6.43:3.13: manussampi kho udāyi, mahantaṃ brūhantaṃ kāyūpapannaṃ jano disvā evamāha:
an6.43:3.15: api ca udāyi yo sadevake loke samārake sabrahmake, sassamaṇabrāhmaṇiyā pajāya sadevamanussāya “āguṃ na karoti kāyena vācāya manasā, tamahaṃ nāgo”ti brūmīti.
an6.43:4.3: “api ca udāyi, yo sadevake loke samārake sabrahmake, sassamaṇabrāhmaṇiyā pajāya sadevamanussāya, āguṃ na karoti kāyena vācāya manasā, tamahaṃ nāgoti brūmī”ti.
an6.43:4.4: idañca panāhaṃ bhante, bhagavato subhāsitaṃ imāhi gāthāhi anumodāmi:
